message:
The function structure that stands is Support parcel, Restrain parcel, Move on flat, Traverse stairs, Limit motion and Collapse frame with the flows on the board, and the selections stand as twin-tube backbone, strap, paired-wheel roll, tri-star climb, dead-man disc plus tooth lock, and folding toe plus sliding handle, because the load path and signal path are coherent and no function is missing. In plain words the device still lifts a suitcase-like tare plus parcel like one heavy suitcase through a domestic door. The numbers that keep it are the parcel weight 589 N (E7), the total lifted mass 66.7 kg (E86) and the folded volume 52.7 L (E42).

Mara Voss will answer the braced deflection objection by calculation with the correct twin-tube cantilever model, Tomas Lind will answer the folded envelope objection by calculation plus a stacked-dimension sketch, Kenji Tanaka will answer the stair work and torque objection by calculation reconciling total against per-side torque, and Elena Ruiz with Mara Voss will answer the lever and tooth engagement objection by calculation against opened push-pull and grip sources. In plain words each blocking check goes to its owner with a method that can settle it without hardware. The numbers that force this are the claimed braced deflection 13.8 mm (E85) against the unbraced whip 0.11 m (E71), the 1100 mm backbone against the folded length 730 mm (E42), and the total torque 67.0 N m (E51) against per-side torque 38.8 N m (E23).

For every numbered constraint Mara Voss will compute parcel and backbone stress by calculation, Tomas Lind will compute folded stack and van clearance by calculation, and Kenji Tanaka will compute stair geometry work by calculation, while over time Elena Ruiz will simulate tipping and stopping hold, Kenji Tanaka will simulate stair traverse effort, and Mara Voss will calculate deployed deflection and disc heating as a formula sum because deflection is static load against stiffness. In plain words sums use calculation and motion over steps uses simulation. The numbers that bind them are the 60 kg parcel rule with 197 mm riser (E22), the door clearance 390 mm (E76) and the stair pull 209 N with hold 188 N (E23).

Not ready, because the four blocking objections on deflection model, folded stack, torque consistency and lever margin are still open and the concept cannot go forward until corrected sums replace them.
Note on Mara Voss: Strong tube stress arithmetic is kept but braced model needs correction.
Note on Kenji Tanaka: Stair energy and torque need total against per-side reconciliation.
Note on Elena Ruiz: Hold exceeds sustained limits so lock margin must be calculated with opened sources.
Note on Tomas Lind: Folded volume alone is kept but stacked lengths must sum to prove fit.
